headline: Humphries beats Littler in a last-leg decider to win the US Darts Masters
standfirst: Luke Humphries won the World Series event at Madison Square Garden, beating Luke Littler 8-7 with a 104.05 average in the final.
body: Luke Humphries won the US Darts Masters at Madison Square Garden in New York, beating Luke Littler 8-7 in a final settled by a deciding leg. Humphries averaged 104.05 and Littler 99.50.

Humphries was in strong form throughout. He averaged 105.70 to beat Stephen Bunting 6-3 in the quarter-finals, although Bunting's 164 checkout in that match was the best of the event. Humphries then edged Gian van Veen 7-6 in a tight semi-final.

Littler reached the final with wins over Jim Long 6-1, averaging 102.15, and James Wade 7-4. Wade averaged 100.26 in that semi-final, having earlier beaten Gerwyn Price 6-3 in a quarter-final where both players averaged over 102.
Van Veen produced the highest average of the tournament, 106.45, in his 6-3 quarter-final win over Jonny Clayton.
Littler led the 180 count with 22, ahead of Humphries on 17. There were 78 in total across the two days in New York.
